optimizations.training_padding: CPU epoch plan crops each unchanged microbatch to its longest candidate, rounded up to 16 tokens (minimum 16).
optimizations.auxiliary_lm: Project only valid next-token positions; weight each token by the inverse length of its own candidate, then average all candidates.
optimizations.device_synchronization: One order copy to CPU per epoch; CPU-known output_size avoids synchronization when building packed CUDA indices.
optimizations.question_order_and_effective_batch: Original seeded CUDA randperm, effective batch and microbatch membership retained.
optimizations.native_backbone: Unchanged native model_bio.py; RACE checkpointing enabled when cropped width exceeds 384 and disabled at or below 384. SST-2 keeps its configured setting.
